# iscc-usearch

> Scalable approximate nearest neighbor search for variable-length binary bit-vectors using the Normalized Prefix Hamming Distance (NPHD) metric.

iscc-usearch is a Python library that extends USearch with sharded HNSW indexes for larger-than-RAM
datasets and the NPHD metric for prefix-compatible binary vector similarity search. Shorter codes
are prefixes of longer codes, enabling mixed bit-length queries. Part of the ISCC (ISO 24138:2024)
content identification ecosystem.

Index classes: NphdIndex (variable-length, in-memory), ShardedIndex (any metric, disk-backed),
ShardedNphdIndex (variable-length, disk-backed), and 128-bit UUID key variants of each.

Sharded indexes support read_only mode (all shards memory-mapped, writes blocked), add_once()
for skip-if-exists semantics (first-write-wins), and reset() for releasing resources without
deleting files on disk.

Install: `pip install iscc-usearch`

- [Source code](https://github.com/iscc/iscc-usearch)
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/iscc-usearch/)
- [Full documentation](https://usearch.iscc.codes/llms-full.txt)

## Tutorials

- [Getting Started](https://usearch.iscc.codes/tutorials/getting-started.md): Installation and first steps with NphdIndex
- [Variable-Length Vectors](https://usearch.iscc.codes/tutorials/variable-length.md): Working with mixed bit-length binary vectors
- [Scaling Up](https://usearch.iscc.codes/tutorials/scaling-up.md): Sharded indexes for larger-than-RAM datasets

## How-to Guides

- [Persistence](https://usearch.iscc.codes/howto/persistence.md): Save, load, and restore indexes to disk
- [Sharding](https://usearch.iscc.codes/howto/sharding.md): Shard indexes across multiple files
- [UUID Keys](https://usearch.iscc.codes/howto/uuid-keys.md): Use 128-bit UUID keys instead of uint64
- [Upsert](https://usearch.iscc.codes/howto/upsert.md): Update and insert vectors
- [Bloom Filters](https://usearch.iscc.codes/howto/bloom-filters.md): Use bloom filters for deduplication
